objective: As the existing Context Capsule Project Manager, integrate only the proven generic Agent Control Plane interoperability contract into Context Capsule v2 / Service Agent Base on v2-manager-runtime. Preserve direct human invocation as first-class and keep the control plane optional. Do not copy gateway-specific infrastructure into Core. Implement the minimal generic contracts/tests needed for bounded external task intake, non-escalating authority transport, target-side mandate validation, execution fencing before consequential writes when a fence is supplied, durable checkpoint/recovery semantics, strict evidence-backed completion, terminal execution-state cleanup, and agent-to-agent routing without mandatory Supervisor mediation.
scope: Project Manager v2 and Universal Service Agent Base contracts/protocols/templates/tests only where the proven abstraction actually applies
Context Capsule durable Project Manager state and handoff required for continuity
constraints: Direct Owner↔Project Manager and Owner↔Service Agent chats remain first-class and must not depend on Scheduled Tasks or Supervisor.
Supervisor must not become a mandatory issuer or development proxy.
Tool access, task delivery, registry membership, and execution lease do not expand agent mandate or target authority.
Agent-issued tasks require explicit authority provenance; the reinstantiated target agent validates actual authority before acting.
When an external execution fence is present, stale/fenced runtimes must not perform consequential writes.
Persist stable checkpoints/evidence only; never hidden chain-of-thought.
Completion must be evidence-backed and terminal execution projection canonicalized.
Keep infrastructure-specific GitHub gateway paths, scheduler IDs, and lease implementation out of generic Context Capsule Core.
Do not modify stable main, publish stable v2, or migrate consumers.
Do not weaken existing CCPM-001 through CCPM-R001 protections.
Run the full permanent test/compile/VALID/READY/recovery/consumer-compatibility/Service-Agent smoke chain.
